status: Follow-up extension specified after inspecting the existing 59-field results; not a preregistered experiment.
purpose: Evaluate PSO-returned allocations relative to the same-budget integer optimum over the existing independent field sample.
field_population: Independent Uniform[1,30] cells on the 50 by 50 grid; reuse all 59 stored Stage 9 E4 fields without selection or exclusion.
seed_rule: For field index i=0,...,58 in ascending e4_01,...,e4_59 order and r=1,...,25, seed=100000+100*i+r. No seeds are reused across fields.

reproduction_gate.failure_action: Do not start the main experiment; report the discrepancy.

evaluation.budget: Use each returned allocation at its own attained budget; merge only identical (field,budget) pairs.
evaluation.lower: Exact rational supporting-plane bound as in stage5_rigor.py: OSQP 1e-8 and active-set refinement; when (V_feasible-L)/U > 1e-9 add OSQP 1e-10 and Clarabel 1e-10, refine from the better extra point; clip the exact lower bound at zero.
evaluation.upper: Minimum exact variance among paper largest-remainder rounding, greedy plus exchange, rounded-index start plus exchange, and every PSO allocation at this field and budget.
evaluation.candidates: OSQP tolerances 1e-8; existing rounding rules; unmodified C++ solver, cap 200 and exchange-move limit 200000. No registry writers are invoked.
evaluation.run_excess_interval: [(P-U)/U,(P-L)/L], exact fractions with outward percentage displays at six decimal places.
evaluation.L_zero: Keep the run and report +Infinity for its excess upper endpoint.
evaluation.U_zero: Relative excess is undefined; retain all records and suppress aggregate population reporting rather than drop a field.
evaluation.exact_inputs: Stored binary64 field values and rebuilt binary64 operator coefficients are interpreted as exact rationals.
evaluation.independent_check: Recompute every supporting-plane witness, feasible continuous value, integer candidate value and per-run excess bracket with a separate standard-library-only checker.

field_statistic: Sample median of the 25 relative excesses; enclose it by the separate medians of the exact lower and upper endpoints. This is not the population median over infinitely many PSO seeds for a fixed field.
quantile_rule: Exact linear interpolation at index (n-1)*p, separately for the interval endpoints; Q1 and Q3 use p=1/4 and 3/4. No outcome-dependent extra summaries.

population_statement.target: Population 5th percentile of the field-level 25-run sample-median excess under the declared field and independent-seed procedure.
population_statement.bound: The sample minimum is a one-sided lower confidence bound; use the minimum of the conservative exact lower endpoints.
population_statement.interpretation: Finite-run field-level statistic, not every field, not a worst-case guarantee and not a median over infinitely many PSO runs.

requested_diagnostics: Completed runs, failed attempts and retries, phase wall times
Number of distinct verified field-budget pairs and range of relative certificate widths
PSO improvements over the three-candidate minimum: number of runs and pairs, with field/budget identifiers
Count of runs with strictly lower recorded global-best variance at iteration 5000 than at 4500, comparing the same history metric without a post hoc tolerance
Position relative to the existing benchmark random-field interval [26.6,26.8] percent: counts definitely above, below or overlapping
failures: Every planned run is kept. Retry a technical execution error once with the identical seed and settings; record both attempts. Do not retry a completed infeasible result as though it were missing. If any run remains missing or infeasible, or any exact verification fails, do not aggregate a partial sample.
outcome_policy: Do not change fields, seeds, algorithm settings or reported statistics after seeing results; report unfavorable outcomes unchanged.
